svg.title: Model predictive control of two heaters on one supply
svg.desc: When heater 1's setpoint rises, the first plan gives heater 1 70 points and takes 10 from heater 2, so the supply stays at 100; both heaters are within 0.2 degrees Celsius of their setpoints from 8 seconds. After 30 kilowatts more are taken from heater 2 the targets need more than the supply, and the plan shares the shortfall equally: both heaters settle 1 degree low with 50 points each.
svg.text: Model predictive control of two heaters on one supply
Control Studio recording of this project · heater 1's setpoint 28 → 31 °C, 30 kW more taken from heater 2 at 60 s · numbers answer the predictions
First plan 70/30: heater 2 gives up 10 points
